text: The Employee shall notify the Company in writing within five business days of receiving any offer of employment or consultancy engagement post-departure, so that the Company may assess compliance with this clause.
label: non_compete

text: The Company may, at its sole discretion, extend the duration of the non-compete period by up to six months in exchange for continued payment of the Employee's base salary during such extension.
label: non_compete

text: The Employee confirms that the non-compete obligations are reasonable and enforceable and expressly waives all rights to contest their validity, scope, or duration in any court or arbitration proceedings.
label: non_compete
